name: wos-jira
description: Standalone Workflow OS Jira standard for consistent Athens IT setup, issue creation, updates, review, description maintenance, and safe Atlassian Rovo MCP/ACLI-backed writes.

interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Jira collects requester identity, department, urgency, and task or issue classification before previewing a customer ticket for approval. Includes optional setup, Jira review and updates, and Rovo/ACLI safety checks. Review past tickets with $jira-repair and apply individually approved corrections.
defaultPrompt: Create, review, or update a Jira ticket. Run $jira-setup only to configure optional defaults.
